items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the announcer Symphony Sid said, “Here is Buddy DeFranco and Miles Davis.”

ctx.x: You had. DeFranco:…yeah, we played some sessions together. And I believe we were on, there was one recording done, from a broadcast—a bootleg—with Stan and I. And also with Miles Davis and I and I used to tell people for years that I never played with Miles Davis.
But at the Royal Roost the announcer Symphony Sid said, “Here is Buddy DeFranco and Miles Davis.” And it became a bootleg record.
